input: A successfully calibrated4096-frame raw sequence; same manifest and sealed judge hashes
reference: Existing causal per-pixel modal RGB background and4-connected components, all foreground components, no semantic palette or teacher
reference_reset: No oracle reset; one continuous history of ordinary pixels across cold episodes
matching: Maximum cardinality of all visible truth centers to predicted centers within4pixels, then minimum distance. One-to-one; stationary truths participate in precision.
motion: Player and ball identity centers changed at least once within the preceding8real frames. Brick runs stay at fixed grid sites and are not moving objects: chipping, splits and merges are geometry changes, not translations.
instances: Unique stable IDs for player and ball; brick runs identified by row and left grid site for visible-frame matching, without motion eligibility
measurement: All frames, including initial background, cold transitions and occlusions. Report moving recall, ball recall, visible precision, raw counts and null for empty denominator.
timing: Raw reference plus judge only; excludes emulator, IPC, branches and learned parser
interpretation: Development instrument diagnostic only. Published alongside previous calibration limits; no gate0 or competence claim.
